Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: CI and Publish

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
    # Only trigger for changes inside portpy/
    paths:
      - 'portpy/**'
  pull_request:
    # Only trigger for PRs touching portpy/
    paths:
      - 'portpy/**'
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          # CPU-only torch (small wheel, no CUDA) so the portpy.ai tests run
          pip install torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
          pip install .[test]

      - name: Run tests
        run: pytest -v --maxfail=1 --disable-warnings

  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    if: github.event_name == 'release' && github.event.action == 'published'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install build tools
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install build twine

      - name: Build package
        run: python -m build

      - name: Publish to PyPI
        env:
          TWINE_USERNAME: __token__
          TWINE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.PYPI_API_TOKEN }}
        run: twine upload dist/*
